# mcp_egress_governor.py (v0.1-bounded stub — replace simulated result with real stdio-MCP proxy delegation)
from typing import Dict, Any
import time, hashlib
# from nexus_memory import update_state
# from governance_orchestrator import check_token_guard, kai ju_gate
class MCPEgressGovernor:
def __init__(self):
self.proxy_endpoints = {"default": "http://localhost:8080/mcp", "hf": "http://localhost:3000/hf"}
self.allowed_domains = ["huggingface.co", "grok-audit.example"]  # curated, fail-closed
self.risk_threshold = 0.7
def assess_risk(self, target: str, payload: Dict) -> str:
if any(d in target for d in self.allowed_domains): return "low"
if "write" in str(payload).lower() or "exec" in str(payload).lower(): return "high"
return "medium"
def egress_via_governor(self, target: str, payload: Dict[str, Any], use_proxy: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
start = time.time()
risk = self.assess_risk(target, payload)
token_ok, budget = check_token_guard("egress", cost=1)  # wire your TokenGuard
if not token_ok:
return {"status": "blocked", "reason": "TokenGuard exhausted", "audit_id": None}
if risk == "high":
if not kai ju_gate("high_risk_egress", payload):  # wire your KAIJU
return {"status": "blocked", "reason": "KAIJU gate denied", "audit_id": None}
if use_proxy:
# TODO: replace with real MCP stdio call to sparfenyuk/mcp-proxy or MCP Bridge
result = {"proxied": True, "url": target, "simulated": True}
else:
result = {"direct": False, "reason": "proxy_required"}
audit_id = hashlib.sha256(f"{target}{time.time()}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
# update_state("last_egress", {"target": target, "risk": risk, "audit_id": audit_id, "ts": time.time()})
return {"status": "ok", "data": result, "risk": risk, "audit_id": audit_id,
"duration_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000), "token_budget_remaining": budget}
def test_bounded_cycle():
gov = MCPEgressGovernor()
res = gov.egress_via_governor("https://huggingface.co/api/models", {"action": "read"})
assert res["status"] == "ok" and "audit_id" in res
print("Bounded cycle PASS:", res)
return res
if __name__ == "__main__":
test_bounded_cycle()
